s215executionLog: Attended S215 — 8 founder-directed items; footer propagated 96 pages; visual overhaul games/projects; pathfinder rebuilt; journal dates exact; Obelisk framing; phantom blocker resolved.

items.title: Footer Projects column — sitewide propagation
items.why: Footer had no Projects column, leaving PromoGrind, Velaxis, Atlas, Forge Window, Studio Pulse, Oracle, and Obelisk undiscoverable from any page footer. A dedicated Projects column closes the discovery gap on 96 pages in a single script pass.
items.recipe: scripts/update-footer.mjs — walks all HTML, replaces Games column + inserts Projects column (10-space indent match). 96 pages updated.
items.evidence: node scripts/update-footer.mjs → 96 updated, 5 skipped (no footer). vaultsparked/index.html fixed separately via inline script.

L1.recipe: Add Projects col to one template page

L2.recipe: Propagate to all HTML via update-footer.mjs

L3.recipe: Generate footer from catalog at build time (derive-dont-hardcode)

items.title: Journal post dates — day-level precision on all 10 posts
items.why: Signal Log posts showed month+year only (e.g. 'March 2026'), which is imprecise and undermines journal credibility. ISO dates already live in article:published_time meta tags — upgrading display is a one-script pass.
items.recipe: scripts/update-journal-dates.mjs — reads article:published_time, formats to 'March 5, 2026', patches post headers + sidebar archive + journal index entries. 11 files updated.
items.evidence: script ran; journal/*/index.html <span class='post-date'> now show full dates.

L3.recipe: Wire into build pipeline as a check/fix gate

items.title: Pathfinder — builder pathway + intel signals + New badge + a11y
items.why: Pathfinder lacked a pathway for tool/project-oriented visitors, had no live intelligence signals, and the intent-graph was missing contexts for /projects/ and /journal/ entirely (falling back to home). The widget was also not accessible (no live region announcement).
items.recipe: assets/intent-flight-director.js — added builder pathway, want_projects hesitation, public-intelligence.json intel signals, node.new badge scoring (+8), aria-live polite region. data/intent-graph.json — added projects/journal contexts + promogrind/velaxis/journal-archive nodes.
items.evidence: build:check EXIT 0. intent-graph contexts for projects/journal confirmed in data/intent-graph.json.

L2.recipe: Full rebuild with intel signals + graph gaps + a11y

L3.recipe: Server-side personalization with RUM-driven pathway learning

items.title: Games + projects landing pages — immersive visual overhaul
items.why: The games/ and projects/ landing pages were static and subdued — no hero gradient depth, no motion, no cross-ecosystem narrative. CANON-041 elite visual craft requires genuinely impressive UI; flat hero sections undercut game/project discovery.
items.recipe: games/index.html, projects/index.html — 3-layer ellipse gradients, clamp() H1, @keyframes gold-pulse on stats, translateY(-5px) card hover + gold ring glow, cross-ecosystem bridge sections before FAQ.

L2.recipe: Full visual layer: gradients + animations + bridge sections

L3.recipe: Template pass across all 20+ individual game/project pages

items.title: Membership + Vault Member pages — Obelisk identity framing
items.why: Membership pages described Vault membership without any forward reference to Obelisk — the unified identity layer that makes a VaultSpark account meaningful across multiple games and tools. Adding honest Phase-0 framing sets expectations and deepens the value proposition.
items.recipe: membership/index.html, vault-member/index.html, vaultsparked/index.html, projects/obelisk/index.html — Obelisk callout panel, cross-game identity sub-copy, Phase-0 honest framing.

L1.recipe: Add one Obelisk sentence to membership page

L3.recipe: Dynamic Obelisk status tile driven by api/public-intelligence.json

items.why: Every regeneration of api/push-config.json was failing the public-contract-health gate because the generator omitted schemaVersion from its output object. Silent recurring gate failure on every push:notify run.

L2.recipe: Add schema validation self-test to the generator

s216candidates.title: Returning-visitor welcome-back badge on game pages
s216candidates.why: Every game page tracks vs_last_game via ambient-loader.js but never shows a welcome-back signal when a returning player lands on the game they last played. A streak-aware animated badge closes the feedback loop that the rank/achievement economy promises. The studio soul demands membership feels real — returning visitors get no personal acknowledgement today.
s216candidates.recipe: In each game page, add JS snippet: read vs_last_game + visit-count key (vs_<slug>_visits), if matching current page slug, increment counter, inject gold-accented .vs-welcome-back badge inside .hero-art-content with 'Welcome back · Nth visit' text, fade-in via CSS transition.

L1.recipe: JS snippet: if vs_last_game=slug, show gold-text badge, fade-in

L2.recipe: L1 + visit-count, streak label, CSS pulse badge

L3.recipe: L2 + momentum strip with last-played timestamp + personal-best stat

s216candidates.title: Extend IGNIS STARTERS_GAME to all game slugs
s216candidates.why: ignis-answer-engine.js STARTERS_GAME only covers cod, fgm, forge. Visitors on mindframe, solara, vaultfront, the-exodus get generic starters — a missed signal that studio intelligence knows them. Game-voice starters in S213 proved click-through; extending to 4 remaining slugs is 30m of copy + 2 verified entries each.
s216candidates.recipe: Add mindframe/solara/vaultfront/the-exodus to STARTERS_GAME in assets/ignis-answer-engine.js, 2 questions each. Verify ignis-project-block data-voice attributes match. Update Worker RUM prefixAllowlist if needed.

L1.recipe: Add 2 starters each for the 4 unserved game slugs

L2.recipe: L1 + verify data-voice attrs + Worker RUM update + rebuild bundle

L3.recipe: L2 + build-time generation from public-intelligence.json for future-proof auto-starters

s216candidates.title: Per-game push-subscribe CTA on game pages
s216candidates.why: Push-subscribe is mature and segmented by game slug but game pages have no push opt-in — only global site footer or /push-subscribe route. A 'Get notified when this game updates' button wired to the game's push segment would dramatically increase opt-in conversion where visitor intent is proven.
s216candidates.recipe: In share section of each game page, add push-subscribe mini-CTA button calling existing push-subscribe.js flow with lastGame=<slug> pre-filled. Show 'Subscribed ✓' on success. Render only if Notification API available.

L1.recipe: Add push-subscribe button in share section with game slug context

L2.recipe: L1 + game accent color + subscribed state detection + RUM event

L3.recipe: L2 + push CTA in community stats bar (gcb) area with engagement tracking

s216candidates.title: Wire journal-date updater into build pipeline
s216candidates.why: update-journal-dates.mjs was a one-off in S215. New Signal Log posts will still appear with month-only dates until founder manually runs it. Wiring as a build:check gate (non-zero on month-only dates) + pre-build fixer eliminates a recurring manual task class.
s216candidates.recipe: Add scripts/check-journal-dates.mjs (errors if any posts have month-only article:published_time). Wire into npm run build:check. Optionally add update-journal-dates.mjs as prebuild script.

L1.recipe: Add check:journal-dates script that exits non-zero on month-only date

L2.recipe: L1 + wire into build:check + pre-build auto-fix

L3.recipe: L2 + CI gate blocks push if new post lacks day-level date

s216candidates.title: S215 visual treatment on all individual game + project pages
s216candidates.why: S215 games/index.html got layered 3-gradient hero, gold-pulse stats, and ecosystem-bridge. Individual game pages still use basic 2-circle radial gradient. Visitor landing on /games/call-of-doodie/ via search gets a substantially less impressive experience than the landing page that referred them — a jarring gap for a studio that prizes visual craft.
s216candidates.recipe: Build scripts/upgrade-individual-pages.mjs: reads each game/project page, upgrades game-hero::before to 3-layer ellipse gradient using per-game accent colors from games/index.html palette, adds gold-pulse keyframe + applies to .stat-block strong, injects ecosystem-bridge section. Run for 10 game pages + 10 project pages.

L1.recipe: Add gold-pulse + 3-layer ellipse gradient to all 10 game pages

L2.recipe: L1 + ecosystem-bridge section on all 20 game + project pages

L3.recipe: L2 + personalized bridge reorders by vs_last_game + page history with RUM tracking
